name: Jugendzeltplatz Kempten
beschreibung: The Jugendzeltplatz Kempten is located in the urban area of Kempten in the Allgäu, near the border with Tirol, Österreich. The facility is geared towards young guests and travel groups and offers simple overnight accommodation in tents. The Allgäuer Alpen with their hiking trails and several ski areas are within easy reach. Amenities include sanitary facilities, a common room, and barbecue areas. Guests can use the surrounding nature for activities such as hiking or skiing. The location also makes it possible to take excursions to the city of Kempten and the wider region of the Allgäu.
